description: A homeowner's washer, dryer, and dishwasher are all failing simultaneously. Open the spreadsheet at /home/ga/Documents/Spreadsheets/appliance_decision.xlsx which contains messy data from retailer quotes, energy ratings, and repair estimates. Create a comprehensive comparison matrix in the 'Comparison Matrix' sheet that calculates 10-year total cost of ownership for each appliance, comparing repair vs. new standard vs. new efficient options. Use formulas to calculate annual energy costs (kWh × rate × years), water costs (gallons × rate × years), and 10-year totals (upfront + energy + water + repair reserves). Include a summary section showing recommended options and total savings. Save the spreadsheet (Ctrl+S).
